Chat request with reasoning_effort none, which turns reasoning off instead of being rejected

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("API_KEY");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle chat_completion_request_handle = literllm_chat_completion_request_from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is 2+2? One word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-5.1\",\"reasoning_effort\":\"none\"}");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_chat(client, chat_completion_request_handle);
    literllm_chat_completion_response_free(result);
    literllm_chat_completion_request_free(chat_completion_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
